_doc: Registry of Newblades (NON-retail) content. Everything listed here is ours, not Bethesda's: retail-fidelity checks read parsed.json and the capture corpus, never this file, and anything that asks 'is this retail?' asks blades_lib::game_data::newblades_content. Design: docs/newblades-content-system.md in dethele-com/newblades-project. Client-side edits for each entry live in that repo under newcontent/<id>.json.

content.summary: Proof that a dungeon can spawn draugr: EQ15's first skeleton group repointed to the Draugr Family client-side, quest name prefixed 'Newblades:'. Borrows a retail event slot for the proof only; no server data changes.
